signals.title: @MarioNawfal: 🚨🇺🇸🇨🇳 A chatbot hallucination nearly had American troops boarding a Chinese ship in the middle of the Iran war An analyst at Special Operati
signals.content: 🚨🇺🇸🇨🇳 A chatbot hallucination nearly had American troops boarding a Chinese ship in the middle of the Iran war An analyst at Special Operations Command asked an AI about a ship's manifest, the bot blended open-source material with classified signals intelligence and decided the vessel was carrying NUCLEAR WEAPON components, and then the same analyst used AI again to write it up as a formal intelligence report that went out across the military. Planes were in the air and armed personnel were preparing to board before somebody finally checked how the report was built and found the whole thing was, in one source's words, entirely false. Another source put it more bluntly, saying it almost started a war, which is not an exaggeration when the target is a Chinese ship. Hegseth's AI strategy in January promised to eliminate bureaucratic barriers and put these models in the hands of three million personnel at every classification level, and this is what that looks like when nobody has agreed on how to verify the output. One official's summary deserves a plaque somewhere in the Pentagon: AI allows you to get to a bad idea faster. Targeting is the next frontier for these tools, with no rules yet for how a human in the loop prevents killing the wrong people, so the question isn't whether this happens again but whether the next one gets caught BEFORE the boarding party leaves... Source: CNN / Writer: Daniel, Lucas

signals.title: DTALEX66/ArcheAxis-Knowledge-OS
signals.content: 星环知识平台 ArcheAxis Knowledge — local-first, evidence-driven, bidirectional Human-AI Learning & Trusted-Knowledge Workspace. NOT an Agent OS. Absorbed: JiWER/RapidFuzz/JSONCanvas/FSRS/Magika/Connectors. Blocked (external): MinerU/Marker/PyMuPDF4LLM/FunASR/tldraw/Firecrawl/H5P/Phoenix/SearXNG. Deps: docs/environment/EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES.md
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; large language model relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: DTALEX66/ArcheAxis-Knowledge-OS

Brief: ArcheAxis Knowledge is a local‑first, evidence‑driven platform that enables bidirectional Human‑AI learning and trusted knowledge management. It integrates core components such as JiWER, RapidFuzz, JSONCanvas, FSRS, Magika, and various connectors to support data ingestion, similarity scoring, structured canvas editing, spaced‑repetition scheduling, and file type detection. The system deliberately excludes external agents; services like MinerU, Marker, PyMuPDF4LLM, FunASR, tldraw, Firecrawl, H5P, Phoenix, and SearXNG are blocked to maintain a closed, privacy‑preserving environment. Documentation of external dependencies is maintained in docs/environment/EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES.md. The platform is positioned as an OSINT‑oriented workspace for strategic analysis, emphasizing verifiable sources and uncertainty preservation.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: DTALEX66/ArcheAxis-Knowledge-OS

الملخص: منصة ArcheAxis Knowledge هي بيئة محلية أولاً، مدفوعة بالأدلة، تمكّن التعلم الثنائي الاتجاه بين الإنسان والذكاء الاصطناعي وإدارة المعرفة الموثوقة. تدمج مكوّنات أساسية مثل JiWER، RapidFuzz، JSONCanvas، FSRS، Magika ومجموعة من الموصلات لدعم استيعاب البيانات، حساب التشابه، تحرير القماش المهيكل، جدولة التكرار المتباعد، واكتشاف أنواع الملفات. تم استبعاد الوكلاء الخارجيين عن عمد؛ حيث تم حجب خدمات مثل MinerU، Marker، PyMuPDF4LLM، FunASR، tldraw، Firecrawl، H5P، Phoenix، وSearXNG للحفاظ على بيئة مغلقة تحافظ على الخصوصية. توثيق الاعتمادات الخارجية موجود في docs/environment/EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES.md. تُصنّف المنصة كمساحة عمل موجهة للـ OSINT للتحليل الاستراتيجي، مع التركيز على المصادر القابلة للتحقق والحفاظ على عدم اليقين.

signals.brief_en: Krebs on Security is a leading independent cybersecurity blog run by journalist Brian Krebs. It provides in‑depth reporting, analysis, and investigation of security incidents, data breaches, ransomware, and threat actor activities. The site aggregates OSINT sources, court documents, and industry disclosures, offering timely insights for security professionals and policymakers. While highly regarded, its coverage depends on publicly available information and occasional leaks, so some details may remain unverified.
signals.brief_ar: Krebs on Security هو مدوّن أمان إلكتروني مستقل يديره الصحفي بريان كريبس. يقدم تقارير وتحليلات وتحقيقات متعمقة حول حوادث الأمن، خروقات البيانات، الفدية، وأنشطة الفاعلين الخطرين. يجمع الموقع مصادر OSINT، وثائق قضائية، وإفصاحات صناعية، موفراً رؤى سريعة للمتخصصين وصانعي السياسات. رغم سمعته الجيدة، يعتمد المحتوى على معلومات متاحة للجمهور وتسريبات محدودة، لذا قد تظل بعض التفاصيل غير مؤكدة.
